description: Git-tracked alignment artifacts used as defaults across TCForge synthetic generation and SR pipelines. As of ACL-048 the default is the Stage 0f refined alignment: contour_refined shifts corrected by the Stage 0a per-frame refinement (centered forward convention, |delta| mean 0.288 px / p95 0.447 px, zero-mean). Validated by convergence (iter2 residual 0.012/0.071 px), drizzle split-half FRC cutoff 29.67->26.28 um, and EP15 M2 authoritative cutoff 34.07->25.45 um with negative controls holding (ACL-047/048).
